title: Europe bows to US pressure to release diesel reserves ahead of midterm elections | CNN

Stated Claim / Post Context:
Europe bows to US pressure to release diesel reserves ahead of midterm elections | CNN

US President Donald Trump announced that Europe has agreed to release “a massive amount of their heavily stocked diesel oil,” following days of pressure to take action to cool surging fuel prices.

Actual Article Body:
US President Donald Trump announced that Europe has agreed to release “a massive amount of their heavily stocked diesel oil,” following days of pressure to take action to cool surging fuel prices.

“The process will begin immediately,” Trump posted on Truth Social Friday.

Trump spoke with French President Emmanuel Macron on Thursday evening and with the G7 leaders this morning to negotiate the release of European diesel stockpiles, a White House official told CNN.

European officials held crisis talks on Friday after the US piled pressure on the region to tap into its emergency stocks of diesel – or face a possible ban on US exports of the fuel.

France released a statement announcing the drawdown after chairing a videoconference of G7 leaders.

Actual Article Body:
The Group of Seven nations plan to release up to 100 million barrels of oil and diesel from its emergency stocks following pressure from the Trump administration.

French President Emmanuel Macron, the G7 chairman, said Friday that the release would be coordinated by the International Energy Agency and would take place over the next four months.
